services.name: Rhone Cruise
services.desc: Join Law Estate Wines on the wine adventure of a lifetime! Alongside Winemaker Phil Pfunder, spend 8 days exploring breathtaking destinations and exciting excursions along the historic Rhône River, the site of inspiration for much of our collection. In addition to exciting excursions, there will be exclusive tastings and events with Winemaker Phil Pfunder throughout the adventure. Taste rare wines from Law Estate alongside some of the finest from the region! We are partnering with Cork & Cruise and Uniworld to curate this luxury experience for our Members and collectors.
